services.heroLead: Sensitive family matters handled with care — marriage, separation, custody, maintenance, and related documentation under Kenyan law.
overview: Family legal issues are personal and often urgent. When you live abroad, coordinating filings, affidavits, and court processes in Kenya can feel overwhelming.
DLSS provides discreet, professional support for family law matters so you can protect your rights and your family’s wellbeing with trusted advocate guidance.
